step: R5 and R6 patent-gate attack from zero

ceo_directive_compliance.pipeline_order: Article XX → exact claim-level patent search → strongest prior-art combination → physical feasibility → hostile failure modes → buyer effect. Patent gate BEFORE physics.
ceo_directive_compliance.directive: R5: attack whether self-clearing geometry repackages known anti-fouling/anti-obstruction geometries. R6: attack whether secondary bypass lumen is already taught. Do NOT use absence of matching patent as novelty.

R5_SELF_CLEARING_GEOMETRY.mechanism: Redesign eShunt lumen geometry so normal CSF flow prevents protein/cellular accumulation. Expanding cross-section, helical flow inducers, surface texturing.

article_xx.q1_problem_exists: YES — shunt obstruction is #1 complication (established in V6/V7)

scopus_evidence.ventricular_catheter_design_obstruction: 64 results — extensive literature on catheter design for obstruction prevention
key_papers: 'A new ventricular catheter for the prevention and treatment of proximal obstruction in CSF shunts' (1994, DOI:10.1227/00006123-199405000-00025) — DIRECTLY teaches obstruction prevention through catheter design
'Long-Term Clinical Outcomes of the Flow Ventricular Catheter' (DOI:10.1227/ons.0000000000001766) — a CLINICALLY DEPLOYED flow-optimized catheter
'The Impact of Ventricular Catheter Biomaterial Selection: Mechanical Properties and Protein Adsorption' — teaches surface/material effects on obstruction
'Contactless Ultrasonic Cavitation for the Prevention of Shunt Obstruction' (DOI:10.1227/ons.0000000000000694) — another prevention approach

analysis.is_r5_novel: WEAK — the concept of preventing shunt obstruction through catheter design is well-established (64 Scopus results, papers from 1994). The 'Flow Ventricular Catheter' is a CLINICALLY DEPLOYED device that uses flow-optimized geometry. R5's concept (geometry prevents obstruction) is NOT novel — it is the established approach to shunt obstruction prevention.
analysis.what_r5_proposes_that_is_known: Expanding cross-section (known), helical flow inducers (known in vascular stents), surface texturing (known — biomaterial/protein adsorption literature). Each individual element is established.
analysis.what_r5_might_add: eShunt-specific geometry optimization. But 'applying known design principles to a new device' is likely obvious, not novel.
analysis.absence_of_matching_patent: Google Patents search returned no shunt-specific self-cleaning geometry patents. But the CEO's principle applies: 'Absence from one patent is not novelty.' The CONCEPT is taught across 64 Scopus papers and multiple patent families.

verdict.102: LIKELY — multiple references teach obstruction prevention through catheter geometry design (1994 paper, Flow Catheter)
verdict.103: LIKELY — combining known flow-optimization principles for the eShunt is obvious
verdict.r5_status: PATENT_THREATENED — core concept (geometry-based obstruction prevention) is well-established in the art

R5_SELF_CLEARING_GEOMETRY.overall_verdict: R5 FAILS patent gate — self-clearing geometry is well-established (64 Scopus results, clinically deployed Flow Catheter). The concept of preventing obstruction through catheter design is NOT novel. Applying it to the eShunt is likely obvious.

R6_LUMEN_REROUTING.mechanism: Secondary bypass lumen opens when primary lumen obstructs, restoring CSF drainage without clearing the obstruction.

scopus_evidence.shunt_bypass_lumen: 2009 results (broad search, many not directly relevant)

google_patents_evidence.key_patent: JP2012071135A (Codman & Shurtleff Inc) — 'Multi-lumen ventricular drainage catheter'
google_patents_evidence.patent_abstract: A shunt having a system for reducing the risk of blockage or obstruction of the catheter apertures. The catheter has an inner lumen that includes AT LEAST TWO LUMENS at the distal end and has only ONE LUMEN at the proximal end.
google_patents_evidence.relevance: DIRECT — Codman's patent teaches a multi-lumen catheter specifically designed to reduce obstruction risk. The secondary lumen provides a redundant flow path when the primary is obstructed. This is EXACTLY R6's mechanism.

also_found.US11896789B2: Shunt Flusher (Boston Childrens) — Claim 1 teaches 'secondary set of drain pores' that open when primary is blocked. This is a FORM of bypass — secondary flow path activated by obstruction. While the mechanism differs (rupturable membrane vs permanent bypass lumen), the CONCEPT of a secondary flow path for obstruction is taught.

analysis.is_r6_novel: NO — the concept of a secondary/bypass lumen for obstruction reduction is directly taught by JP2012071135A (Codman). The Shunt Flusher (US11896789B2) also teaches secondary drain pores as a bypass mechanism.
analysis.what_r6_proposes_that_is_known: Multi-lumen catheter with secondary flow path (Codman), secondary pores activated by obstruction (Shunt Flusher). Both are established.
analysis.what_r6_might_add: eShunt-specific bypass lumen design. But applying a known multi-lumen concept to the eShunt is likely obvious.

verdict.102: LIKELY — JP2012071135A teaches multi-lumen catheter for obstruction reduction. The concept of a secondary lumen as bypass is directly taught.
verdict.103: LIKELY — applying multi-lumen bypass to eShunt is obvious over Codman + Shunt Flusher
verdict.r6_status: PATENT_KILLED — core concept (secondary bypass lumen for obstruction) is directly taught by JP2012071135A

R6_LUMEN_REROUTING.overall_verdict: R6 FAILS patent gate — multi-lumen bypass catheter for obstruction reduction is directly taught by JP2012071135A (Codman & Shurtleff). The concept of a secondary flow path as bypass is established.

V15_SUMMARY.R5_self_clearing_geometry: FAILS — 64 Scopus results for catheter design obstruction prevention. Clinically deployed Flow Catheter. Concept is established, not novel.
V15_SUMMARY.R6_lumen_rerouting: FAILS — JP2012071135A (Codman) teaches multi-lumen catheter for obstruction reduction. Secondary bypass lumen concept is directly taught.
V15_SUMMARY.pipeline_working: Both candidates died at the cheapest decisive gate (patent search) before any physics modeling. This is the correct pipeline behavior.

remaining_candidates.R8_ultrasound: Still viable — external acoustic energy is a different mechanism. Patent gate not yet run.
remaining_candidates.R9_sacrificial_cartridge: Still viable — replaceable obstruction zone is a different mechanism. Patent gate not yet run.
remaining_candidates.note: R8 and R9 have NOT been attacked yet. They start at zero. Do not assume they survive because R5/R6 died.
